story.text:
# Who is involved

**Active cast.** "We're going to do it ourselves." For the Time Bank: the team (the mice), with "anyone who has initially committed 42 hours" named as involved: "the mice the vision fish the early hitchhiker slicing the pie guy." For the visualization: "Mitch because he's doing all these weird visualizations right now," plus "whoever's doing our branding and our graphic design" (paid). Penciled in: "amp and drew and rachel and jade" ("indicated they are open to it but I still haven't really followed up"). References to "mary and art" who "built the time bank before holochain."

**Being invited or network activated.** A "call out" to "time banks and software and software hackathons" to "come and vibe code it with us"; interviews with key time-banking and dynamic-equity figures; "myco who hosted the conference"; Holochain, Circles, UBI. For visualization: Nicole's TV design students (course "in september onwards"), Nordcraft, the Open Global Mind community, Obsidian, and "the guy who does video.ninja" for vibe-coding Hitchhiker TV.
See [[Time Bank & Trust Graph]]  ·  hub: [[Who is Involved?]]
